queries: GPT-4o API price $2.50 per million input tokens $10 output OpenAI

sources_considered.why: Shows OpenAI had shipped a cheaper small model, GPT-4o mini. Context only, since a cheaper small model is not the DeepSeek-style effort the claim means.

receipt.public_excerpt: GPT-4o mini is our most cost-efficient small model that’s smarter and cheaper than GPT-3.5 Turbo, and has vision capabilities.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI did sell a cost-efficient small model before the post. Whether that counts as the efficiency 'it' in the claim, and why the firms acted as they did, cannot be settled from this.

unresolved_gaps: There is no public record of why OpenAI and Anthropic chose their spending and efficiency strategies.
There is no agreed standard for what would count as having 'done' DeepSeek-style efficiency work.
